item.title: How a runaway AI agent burns a month's budget overnight, and five ways to stop it
item.dc:creator: Younus S. Mohammed
item.description: A retry loop or an agent that keeps re-planning can spend real money while nobody is watching. Here are five controls, what each one misses, and where provider spend limits help and where they don't.

item.title: How to find out what each customer costs you in OpenAI or Anthropic spend
item.dc:creator: Younus S. Mohammed
item.description: Your AI bill is one number. Here are three ways to break it down by customer, what each one misses, and how to check your numbers against the provider's invoice.
